subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink market authorisation
what_would_settle_it: An ARPT licensing decision, a published authorisation register, or a ministerial statement on Starlink market entry.

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth-observation or satellite data programme
what_would_settle_it: A national earth-observation or geospatial-data programme document, or an agency mandate covering satellite data.

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital-services programme
what_would_settle_it: A rural connectivity or rural digital-services programme document, or the white-zones plan named in the 2026 targets.

subject: gov.discourse
name: Official explanation of the social-media restriction
what_would_settle_it: Any published legal basis, ARPT decision or ministerial statement acknowledging the restriction on Facebook, YouTube and TikTok.

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A national open-data portal, an open-data policy, or a public-sector information reuse instrument.

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National AI strategy
what_would_settle_it: The national AI roadmap document named in open sources, with its validation date and adopting instrument.

subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Chinese digital investment in Guinea
what_would_settle_it: A Guinea-specific Chinese financing agreement, contract or memorandum covering digital infrastructure.

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Startup act or innovation-financing instrument
what_would_settle_it: A startup act, an innovation fund instrument, or a published incubation or venture programme.

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital cooperation with Guinea
what_would_settle_it: Any India-Guinea digital cooperation agreement, line of credit or programme document.

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital investment in Guinea
what_would_settle_it: Any Gulf-state investment, financing or memorandum covering Guinean digital infrastructure.

subject: capacity.research
name: Public research programme in digital or data science
what_would_settle_it: A public research programme, university research centre mandate or published research output in digital or data science.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programme or measurement
what_would_settle_it: A digital-literacy programme document, or a published measurement of digital literacy.

subject: finance.budget

what_would_settle_it: The Loi de finances or its annexes showing appropriation lines for MCENI, ANDE, ANSSI or the Digital Sovereignty Fund.
